# ClutchIQ

> ClutchIQ ranks IPL and T20I batters and bowlers by performance under pressure, using ball-by-ball data from 2022.

- [Home](https://clutchiq.vercel.app/): overview and top three players
- [Methodology](https://clutchiq.vercel.app/methodology): pressure index, ratings, limitations
- [Pricing](https://clutchiq.vercel.app/pricing): free plan and planned Pro plan
- [Contact](https://clutchiq.vercel.app/contact): devprakashsahu348@gmail.com
- [Privacy](https://clutchiq.vercel.app/privacy), [Terms](https://clutchiq.vercel.app/terms), [Cookies](https://clutchiq.vercel.app/cookies), [Payment terms](https://clutchiq.vercel.app/payment-terms)
